urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Pages to capture. 'https://' is added when the scheme is missing. Private network addresses (localhost, 10.x, 192.168.x and similar) are refused.

format.title: Format
format.description: Output file type. PDF is printed on A4 pages with backgrounds.

fullPage.title: Full page
fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable page. Turn off to capture only the viewport. Ignored for PDF.

viewportWidth.title: Viewport width
viewportWidth.description: Browser window width in CSS pixels.

viewportHeight.title: Viewport height
viewportHeight.description: Browser window height in CSS pixels.

deviceScaleFactor.title: Device scale factor
deviceScaleFactor.description: Pixel density. 2 gives retina-sharp images at four times the pixel count.

mobile.title: Mobile
mobile.description: Emulate a phone: 390x844 viewport, scale factor 3, mobile layout and touch. Overrides the viewport and scale fields. The browser's own user agent is kept.

darkMode.title: Dark mode
darkMode.description: Ask the page for its dark color scheme (prefers-color-scheme: dark).

waitUntil.title: Wait until
waitUntil.description: Page event to wait for before capturing. 'networkidle' is slowest and suits pages that load content with JavaScript.

delayMs.title: Extra delay (ms)
delayMs.description: Extra wait after the page has loaded, for animations and late content.

selector.title: Element selector
selector.description: Optional CSS selector. Only the first matching element is captured. Ignored for PDF.

hideSelectors.title: Hide selectors
hideSelectors.description: CSS selectors of elements to hide before capturing, for example cookie banners or chat widgets.

maxPageHeight.title: Max page height (px)
maxPageHeight.description: Full-page captures of longer pages are clipped to this height in CSS pixels.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per page (s)
timeoutSecs.description: Maximum time for a page to load.
